headlines.title: Nvidia enters the post-Jensen Huang era with a bang
headlines.description: Nvidia delivered a message with its first earnings report under new leadership: The sky isn’t falling.

headlines.title: Waymo pauses robotaxi rides on U.S. freeways after California ban
headlines.description: Waymo will stop putting its driverless vehicles on U.S. freeways for now.

headlines.title: Apple outages appear to be resolved after an internal update took popular services offline
headlines.description: Outages affecting several popular Apple services appeared to be resolved Tuesday night, after an internal update had taken them offline during the afternoon.

headlines.title: U.S. closes loophole that let Chinese companies use top AI chips in foreign data centers
headlines.description: The Commerce Department further restricted the sale of American AI chips, addressing concerns about how Chinese companies might evade U.S. export restrictions.

headlines.title: NVIDIA says Jensen Huang will not return as CEO
headlines.description: On an earnings call announcing blockbuster revenue, the chipmaker’s Board Chair said Jensen Huang would not be reinstated as CEO. NBC News’ Brian Cheung reports.

headlines.title: How the U.S. military is using high-powered microwave systems to stop drone attacks
headlines.description: As drone warfare increasingly becomes the norm in global conflicts from Iran to Ukraine, the U.S. military is using high-powered microwave systems as a new line of defense. NBC News’ Courtney Kube takes a look at the new technology that can knock out dozens of drones at once.

headlines.title: Tech giant Apple suffers widespread outages
headlines.description: Apple pay, music, and a number of other apps went down today as the most valuable publicly traded company in the world became the latest to experience major technical problems. Apple says the issues were not caused by a cyber attack. NBC News’ Tom Costello reports.

headlines.title: Nvidia board does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang, chairman says
headlines.description: The Nvidia board "does not intend to reinstate" Jensen Huang as CEO, the newly appointed board chair, Harvey Jones, said on their quarterly earnings call. NBC News' Allie Canal and Sahil Kapur discuss how Nvidia topped estimates despite Huang's ouster.

headlines.title: Outages reported at the NSA and Apple
headlines.description: A classified computer network used by the National Security Agency went down due to a technical problem. It comes as Apple was experiencing a tech issue that was affecting a several of its consumer-facing services. Mitch Ashley, VP of the Futurum Group, discusses how concerned we should be after several outages were reported across banking, aviation and tech.

headlines.title: Crash Involving Waymo Self-Driving Cars in Phoenix Injures 3
headlines.description: Surveillance video shows the moment an SUV crashed into two Waymo self-driving cars in Phoenix. Three people were hospitalized, with at least one suffering life-threatening injuries.

headlines.title: Jensen Huang says he would be 'honored' to return to Nvidia as CEO
headlines.description: In his first public comments since stepping down, Jensen Huang says he “would be honored” to return as CEO of Nvidia if asked by the board of directors. NBC News’ Allie Canal and editor-in-chief at Investopedia, Caleb Silver, break down Huang’s remarks and what they could mean for the company’s future leadership.

headlines.title: Outages impact Chase banking online and in person
headlines.description: A nationwide outage is impacting Chase banking services, leading some customers to report trouble accessing their accounts and withdrawing funds. The issues were affecting both online and in-person branch transactions. NBC News' Brian Cheung discusses whether there is any relation to the Microsoft outage or FAA ground stop.
